planning_notes: D2 button uses internal pull-up (INPUT_PULLUP); low level indicates pressed, so the model value is true when pressed.
D13 LED turns on while the button is pressed and turns off when released.
Output/response deadline is <=20ms; control_period_ms=5ms provides margin.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Button input (INPUT_PULLUP); model true when pressed (LOW level).

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: LED output; ON when button is pressed.

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
当按下连接在 D2 引脚的按钮（上拉输入）时，点亮 D13 LED，松开时熄灭。
验收约定：使用INPUT_PULLUP，低电平表示按下；输出响应时间不超过20ms。
